title: Ranglar, kiyim va do'konda xarid
goal_uz: Dars oxirida rang va kiyim nomlarini aytasiz, rangni namuna (ismi) ga moslashtirasiz, “bu” va “shu” belgilarini ishlatasiz, hajm va “kiritish” haqida so‘rayasiz va do‘kon’da palto xarid qilganingizdan xabar berasiz.

scenes.title: O‘n ikkinchi dars: ranglar va kiyim
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! O‘n ikkinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan darsda shaharda yo‘l so‘rashni o‘rgandik. Bugun ranglar, kiyim va do‘konda xaridni o‘rganamiz: ranglarni ayirish, ularni nomaniga moslashishtirish, “bu” va “shu” belgilari, hajm va kiritish, narhni so‘rash. Dars oxirida kiyimingizni tasvirlaysiz va palto xaridlashni simulyatsiya qilasiz. Boshlaymiz.
scenes.say: Welcome to lesson twelve. Today we learn colours, clothes and shopping for clothes.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n ikkinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Bugun ranglar, kiyim va xaridni o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: Birinchi to‘rtta rang
scenes.say_native: Avval to‘rtta rang. “Abyaḍu” — oq, “aswadu” — qora, “aḥmaru” — qizil, “akhḍaru” — yashil. Bu ranglar erkak jinsli ismlarga mos keladi: “qamīṣun abyaḍun” — oq kirtka. “Thawbun aswadun” — qora kiyim. O‘zbek tilida rang o‘zgarmaydi, arabchada esa isimning jinsiga mos keladi. “Abyaḍ” — oq, erkak; “bayḍāʾ” — oq, ayol. Shunigina farqni eslab qoling.
scenes.say: Abyad, aswad, ahmar, akhdar. White, black, red, green.
scenes.say_uz: Abyad, aswad, ahmar, akhdar. Oq, qora, qizil, yashil.

scenes.title: Yana to‘rtta rang
scenes.say_native: Yana to‘rtta rang. “Azraqu” — ko‘k, “aṣfaru” — sariq, “bunniyyun” — jigar rang, “rumādirun” — kulrang. “Sirwālun azraqun” — ko‘k shim. “Thawbun aṣfarun” — sariq kiyim. “Bunnī” va “rumādī” nisbi rango‘lar, ular ham ismga mos keladi. “Khuffun bunniyyun” — jigar rang po‘tafz. Endi jami sakkizta rangni bilasiz.
scenes.say: Azraq, asfar, bunni, rumadi. Blue, yellow, brown, grey.
scenes.say_uz: Azraq, asfar, bunnī, rumādī. Ko‘k, sariq, jigar rang, kulrang.

scenes.title: Rang toping
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Beshta rangni arabcha ayting: oq, qora, qizil, yashil, ko‘k. Har birini baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Say the Arabic words for white, black, red, green and blue.
scenes.say_uz: Arabcha ayting: oq, qora, qizil, yashil, ko‘k.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: abyaḍu. Aswadu. Aḥmaru. Akhḍaru. Azraqu. Bu beshta rangni yaxshi yodlab oling, keyingi darda kiyimning rangini aytishda kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Abyad, aswad, ahmar, akhdar, azraq.
scenes.say_uz: Abyad, aswad, ahmar, akhdar, azraq.

scenes.title: Kiyim: birinchi to‘rt
scenes.say_native: Endi kiyimlar. “Qamīṣun” — kirtka, “sirwālun” — shim, “ḥidhāʾun” — po‘tafz, “jubbatu” — palto. “Qamīṣ” erkak jinsli, “jubbah” ayol jinsli. “Qamīṣun abyaḍun” — oq kirtka. “Jubbatu bayḍāʾin” — oq palto. “Ḥidhāʾun aswadun” — qora po‘tafz. “Sirwālun azraqun” — ko‘k shim. Bu kiyimlar do‘kon’da xarid qilganda kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Qamis, sirwal, hida, jubba. Shirt, trousers, shoes, coat.
scenes.say_uz: Qamis, sirwal, hida, jubba. Kirtka, shim, po‘tafz, palto.

scenes.title: Kiyim: yana to‘rt
scenes.say_native: Yana to‘rtta kiyim. “Thawbun” — kiyim, “qubbaʿatun” — lopi, “khuffun” — paymona, “qifāzun” — qavat. “Thawb” erkak jinsli, “qubbaʿa” ayol jinsli. “Khuffun abyāḍ” — oq paymona. “Qifāzun aswad” — qora qavat. “Thawbun jadīdun” — yangi kiyim. Bu kiyimlar ham do‘kon’da keng ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: Thawb, qubba, khuff, qifaz. Clothes, hat, socks, gloves.
scenes.say_uz: Thawb, qubba, khuff, qifaz. Kiyim, lopi, paymona, qavat.

scenes.title: Kiyim nomlang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Beshta kiyimni arabcha ayting: kirtka, shim, po‘tafz, palto, lopi. Har birini baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Say the Arabic words for shirt, trousers, shoes, coat and hat.
scenes.say_uz: Arabcha ayting: kirtka, shim, po‘tafz, palto, lopi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: qamīṣun. Sirwālun. Ḥidhāʾun. Jubbatu. Qubbaʿatun. “Jubbah” va “qubbaʿa” ta marbuta bilan tugaydi, ular ayol jinsli. “Qamīṣ”, “sirwāl”, “ḥidhāʾ”, “khuff” erkak jinsli. Bu farqni eslab qoling. Endi rangni kiyimga moslashishtirishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Qamis, sirwal, hida, jubba, qubba.
scenes.say_uz: Qamis, sirwal, hida, jubba, qubba.

scenes.title: Rangni ismga moslashishtirish
scenes.say_native: Rang ismga mos keladi. “Qamīṣun abyaḍun” — oq kirtka. “Jubbatu bayḍāʾin” — oq palto. “Sirwālun aḥmarun” — qizil shim. “Thawbatun ḥamrāʾin” — qizil kiyim. “Qamīṣ” erkak, shuning uchun “abyaḍ”; “jubbah” ayol, shuning uchun “bayḍāʾ”. “Thawb” erkak, shuning uchun “aḥmar”. “Jigar rang kirtka” — “qamīṣun bunnīyun”. Endi shu qoidaning tafaqquti bor, lekin A1-da bunday shakllarni bilish yetarli.
scenes.say: Qamisan abyad white shirt. Jubba bayda white coat. Colour agrees with the noun.
scenes.say_uz: Qamisan abyad — oq kirtka. Jubba bayda — oq palto. Rang ismga mos keladi.

scenes.title: Rang mos kelish xatosi
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: “jubbatu abyaḍun” noto‘g‘ri, chunki jubbah ayol, rang ham ayol bo‘lishi kerak: “jubbatu bayḍāʾin”. Ikkinchisi: “qamīṣun bayḍāʾin” noto‘g‘ri, chunki qamīṣ erkak, rang erkak bo‘lishi kerak: “qamīṣun abyaḍun”. O‘zbek tilida rang o‘zgarmaydi, arabchada esa ismning jinsiga mos keladi. “Oq kirtka” — “qamīṣun abyaḍun”, “oq palto” — “jubbatu bayḍāʾin”.
scenes.say: Jubba bayda, not jubba abyad. Qamis abyad, not qamis bayda.
scenes.say_uz: Jubba bayda, jubba abyaid emas. Qamis abyad, qamis bayda emas.

scenes.title: Rangni moslang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta iborani arabcha ayting. Birinchi: oq kirtka. Ikkinchi: qora palto. Uchinchi: yashil shim. To‘rtinchi: ko‘k kiyim. Rangning jinsini unutmang: kirtka erkak, palto ayol.
scenes.say: A white shirt. A black coat. Green trousers. A blue dress.
scenes.say_uz: Oq kirtka. Qora palto. Yashil shim. Ko‘k kiyim.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: qamīṣun abyaḍun. Jubbatu sawdāʾin. Sirwālun akhḍarun. Thawbun azraq. “Sawdāʾ” — qora, ayol shakli. “Akhdar” — yashil, erkak. “Azraq” — ko‘k, erkak. Har birida rang ismga mos. Endi “bu” va “shu” belgilarini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Qamis abyad. Jubba sawda. Sirwal akhdar. Thawb azraq.
scenes.say_uz: Qamis abyad — oq kirtka. Jubba sawda — qora palto. Sirwal akhdar — yashil shim. Thawb azraq — ko‘k kiyim.

scenes.title: Bu va shu: hādhā, hādhihi
scenes.say_native: “Hādhā” — bu, erkak uchun. “Hādhihi” — bu, ayol uchun. “Dhālika” — shu, erkak uchun. “Tilka” — shu, ayol uchun. “Hādhā qamīṣun” — bu kirtka. “Hādhihi jubbatu” — bu palto. “Dhālika as-sūqu” — shu bozor. “Tilka al-madrasatu” — shu maktab. “Hādhā” va “hādhihi” yaqin narsa uchun, “dhālika” va “tilka” — faraqsiz narsa uchun. Endi kiyimni ko‘rsatishda ishlatamiz.
scenes.say: Hadha, hadhihi, dhalika, tilka. This and that.
scenes.say_uz: Hada, hadhi, dhalika, tilka. Bu va shu.

scenes.title: Bu va shu
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta iborani arabcha ayting. Birinchi: bu kirtka. Ikkinchi: bu palto. Uchinchi: shu bozor. To‘rtinchi: shu maktab. “Hādhā” va “hādhihi” ni to‘g‘ri tanlang.
scenes.say: This is a shirt. This is a coat. That is the market. That is the school.
scenes.say_uz: Bu kirtka. Bu palto. Shu bozor. Shu maktab.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: hādhā qamīṣun. Hādhihi jubbatu. Dhālika as-sūqu. Tilka al-madrasatu. “As-sūq” aniq, shuning uchun “dhālika as-sūq”. Endi do‘kon’da xaridni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Hada qamis. Hadhi jubba. Dhalika suq. Tilka madrasa.
scenes.say_uz: Hada qamis — bu kirtka. Hadhi jubba — bu palto. Dhalika suq — shu bozor. Tilka madrasa — shu maktab.

scenes.title: Hajm: katta, kichik, o‘rta
scenes.say_native: Hajm sifatlari: “kabīrun” — katta, “ṣaghīrun” — kichik, “wasaṭun” — o‘rta. “Qamīṣun kabīrun” — katta kirtka. “Jubbatu ṣaghīrah” — kichik palto. “Sirwālun wasaṭun” — o‘rta shim. “Kabīr” erkak, “ṣaghīrah” ayol. “Wasaṭ” erkak. “Qifāzun kabīr” — katta qavat. Endi hajmni kiyimga qo‘shamiz.
scenes.say: Kabir, saghir, wasat. Big, small, medium.
scenes.say_uz: Kabir, saghir, wasat. Katta, kichik, o‘rta.

scenes.title: Kiritish va narh
board: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُجَرِّبَهُ — men uni kiritmoqchiman
scenes.say_native: Xaridda: “urīdu an ujarrībahu” — men uni kiritmoqchiman. “Kam thamanuhu?” — uning narhi qancha? “ʿArīs” — qimmat, “rakhīṣ” — arzon. “Jubbatun ʿarīsatun” — qimmat palto. “Qamīṣun rakhīṣun” — arzon kirtka. “Thaman” — narh. “Thamanuhu kām?” — uning narhi qancha? Do‘kon sotuvchisi bilan suhbatlashishda bu iboralar zarur.
scenes.say: Uridu an ajarriba hu. Kam thamanu hu? I want to try it on. How much is it?
scenes.say_uz: Uridu an ujarribahu — men uni kiritmoqchiman. Kam thamanu hu — uning narhi qancha?

scenes.title: Kiritish va narh
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta gapni arabcha ayting. Birinchi: men uni kiritmoqchiman. Ikkinchi: uning narhi qancha? Uchinchi: u qimmat. To‘rtinchi: u arzon. “Urīdu an ujarrībahu” va “kam thamanuhu?” ni ishlating.
scenes.say: I want to try it on. How much is it? It is expensive. It is cheap.
scenes.say_uz: Men uni kiritmoqchiman. Uning narhi qancha? U qimmat. U arzon.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: urīdu an ujarrībahu. Kam thamanuhu? Huwa ʿarīs. Huwa rakhīṣ. “Huwa” — u. “ʿArīs” — qimmat, “rakhīṣ” — arzon. Endi dialog ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: I want to try it on. How much is it? It is expensive. It is cheap.
scenes.say_uz: Men uni kiritmoqchiman. Uning narhi qancha? U qimmat. U arzon.

scenes.title: Birinchi dialog: palto xarid
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog. Mushtori “urīdu jubbatan, min faḍlika” — men palto olmoqchiman, iltimos. Sotuvchi “ayyu jubbatin?” — qaysi palto? Mushtori “hādhihi jubbatu bayḍāʾin” — bu oq palto. Sotuvchi “thamanuhu miʾatu dirham” — uning narhi yuz so‘m. “Miʾah” — yuz. “Dirham” — so‘m. “Jubbatan” — palto, noaniq obyekt “-an” bilan. Endi o‘zingiz xaridlashingiz mumkin.
scenes.say: I want a coat, please. Which one? This white coat. Its price is one hundred som.
scenes.say_uz: Men palto olmoqchiman, iltimos. Qaysi palto? Bu oq palto. Uning narhi yuz so‘m.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Birinchi: mushtori nima olmoqchi? Ikkinchi: qaysi palto? Uchinchi: narh qancha? To‘rtinchi: sotuvchi nima deyadi? Dialogdan javob bering.
scenes.say: What does the customer want to buy? Which coat? How much is the price? What does the seller say?
scenes.say_uz: Sotuvchi nima deyadi? Narh qancha? Qaysi palto? Xarid qiluvchi nima olmoqchi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: mushtori jubbatan olmoqchi — palto. “Hādhihi jubbatu bayḍāʾin” — bu oq palto. “Thamanuhu miʾatu dirham” — uning narhi yuz so‘m. Sotuvchi “thamanuhu miʾatu dirham” deyadi. “Miʾah” — yuz. Bu to‘liq xaridlash dialogi. Endi o‘zingiz xaridlashingiz mumkin.
scenes.say: A coat. This white coat. Its price is one hundred som. Its price is one hundred som.
scenes.say_uz: Palto. Bu oq palto. Uning narhi yuz so‘m. Sotuvchi narhni deyadi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: ranglar
scenes.say_native: Ranglar talaffuzi. “Abyaḍ” — ab-yaḍ, “y” aniq. “Aswad” — as-wad, “w” undosh. “Aḥmar” — aḥ-mar, “ḥ” tomoqdan. “Akhdar” — akh-ḍar, “kh” tomoqdan chuqur. Har birini ikki marta baland ovozda takrorlang. Ranglarni aytganda hamza va tomoq harflarga e‘tibor bering.
scenes.say: Abyad, aswad, ahmar, akhdar.
scenes.say_uz: Abyad, aswad, ahmar, akhdar.

scenes.title: Baland ovozda takrorlang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta rangni baland ovozda takrorlang: abyaḍ, aswad, aḥmar, akhḍar. Har birini ikki marta ayting.
scenes.say: Repeat: white, black, red, green.
scenes.say_uz: Takrorlang: oq, qora, qizil, yashil.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar to‘g‘ri. Abyaḍ, aswad, aḥmar, akhḍar. Endi o‘zingizning kiyimingizni tasvirlaymiz.
scenes.say: White, black, red, green.
scenes.say_uz: Oq, qora, qizil, yashil.

scenes.title: Kiyimingizni tasvirlang
scenes.say_native: Endi sizning navbatingiz. Kiymagan kiyimingizni tasvirlang: rang + kiyim + hajm. “Hādhā qamīṣun abyaḍun kabīrun” — bu katta oq kirtka. “Hādhihi jubbatu bayḍāʾin ṣaghīrah” — bu kichik oq palto. Sekin va aniq gapiring.
scenes.say: Describe what you are wearing.
scenes.say_uz: Kiymagan kiyimingizni tasvirlang.

scenes.title: O‘z-o‘zini tekshirish
scenes.say_native: Tekshiring. Birinchi: rang ismga mos kelganmi? Ikkinchi: “hādhā” yoki “hādhihi” bormi? Uchinchi: hajm (kabīr, ṣaghīr, wasaṭ) bormi? To‘rtinchi: kiyim nomi bormi? Har biriga “ha” desangiz, vazifa bajarildi.
scenes.say: Check colour agreement, this/that, size and clothing noun.
scenes.say_uz: Rang mosligi, bu/shu, hajm va kiyim nomini tekshiring.

scenes.title: Yana kiyim
scenes.say_native: Yana to‘rtta kiyim. “Qifāzun” — qavat, “miʾzarun” — kiyim-kechak, “ḥizām” — kamar, “shāl” — shal. “Qifāz” erkak jinsli, “miʾzar” erkak, “ḥizām” erkak, “shāl” erkak. “Qifāzun abyāḍ” — oq qavat. “Miʾzarun aswad” — qora kiyim-kechak. “Ḥizāmun azraq” — ko‘k kamar. “Shālun akhḍar” — yashil shal. Endi barcha kiyimlarni yaxshiroq yodlab oling.
scenes.say: Qifaz, mizar, hizam, shal. Gloves, apron, belt, scarf.
scenes.say_uz: Qifaz, mizar, hizam, shal. Qavat, kiyim-kechak, kamar, shal.

scenes.title: Yana kiyim
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Beshta kiyimni arabcha ayting: qavat, kiyim-kechak, kamar, shal, lopi. Har birini baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Say gloves, apron, belt, scarf and hat.
scenes.say_uz: Arabcha ayting: qavat, kiyim-kechak, kamar, shal, lopi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: qifāzun. Miʾzarun. Ḥizām. Shālun. Qubbaʿatun. “Shāl” va “qubbaʿa” ayol jinsli, “qifāz”, “miʾzar”, “ḥizām” erkak jinsli. Endi “mening o‘lchamim” ni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Qifaz, mizar, hizam, shal, qubba.
scenes.say_uz: Qifaz, mizar, hizam, shal, qubba.

scenes.title: O‘lcham so‘rash
board: عِنْدَكَ هَذَا بِحَجْمِي؟ — sizda mening o‘lchamimda bormi?
أُرِيدُ حَجْمًا كَبِيرًا — katta o‘lcham kerak
أُرِيدُ حَجْمًا صَغِيرًا — kichik o‘lcham kerak
scenes.say_native: Do‘kon’da o‘lcham so‘rash: “ʿindaka hādhā bi ḥajmī?” — sizda mening o‘lchamimda bormi? “Urīdu ḥajman kabīran” — men katta o‘lcham kerak. “Urīdu ḥajman ṣaghīran” — men kichik o‘lcham kerak. “Bi ḥajmī” — mening o‘lchamimda. “Ḥajm” — o‘lcham. “Kabīran” — katta (inkor shaklida “-an”). “Ṣaghīran” — kichik. Sotuvchi “hādhā fī al-ḥajm” deb javob bera oladi — bu mening o‘lchamimda.
scenes.say: Indaka hadha bi hajmi? Uridu hajman kabiran. Uridu hajman saghiran.
scenes.say_uz: Indaka hadha bi hajmi? Uridu hajman kabiran. Uridu hajman saghiran.

scenes.title: O‘lcham so‘rang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta gapni arabcha ayting. Birinchi: men katta o‘lcham kerak. Ikkinchi: men kichik o‘lcham kerak. Uchinchi: sizda mening o‘lchamimda bormi? To‘rtinchi: u (erkak) uchun katta. “Urīdu ḥajman kabīran” va “urīdu ḥajman ṣaghīran” ni ishlating.
scenes.say: I need a large size. I need a small size. Do you have it in my size? For him, large.
scenes.say_uz: Men katta o‘lcham kerak. Men kichik o‘lcham kerak. Sizda mening o‘lchamimda bormi? U uchun katta.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: urīdu ḥajman kabīran. Urīdu ḥajman ṣaghīran. ʿIndaka hādhā bi ḥajmī? Huwa kabīrun. “Kabīrun” — katta, “ṣaghīrun” — kichik. “Huwa kabīrun” — u katta. Endi “olaman” va “olmayman” ni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Uridu hajman kabiran. Uridu hajman saghiran. Indaka hadha bi hajmi. Huwa kabir.
scenes.say_uz: Uridu hajman kabiran. Uridu hajman saghiran. Indaka hadha bi hajmi. Huwa kabir.

scenes.title: Olaman / olmayman
scenes.say_native: Xarid javobi: “ushtarih” — men uni olaman. “Lā ushtarih” — men uni olmayman. “Akhdhuh” — men uni olaman. “Tarakhtuh” — men uni qoldirdim. “Ushtarihi jubbatan” — men uni (paltoni) olaman. “Tarakhtuha” — men uni qoldirdim. “Nāʿam, ushtarih” — ha, olaman. “Lā, lā ushtarih” — yo‘q, olmayman. Endi dialog ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: Ushtarihi. La ushtarihi. Akhdhuh. Tarakhtuh.
scenes.say_uz: Ushtarihi — men uni olaman. La ushtarihi — men uni olmayman.

scenes.title: Olaman / olmayman
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta gapni arabcha ayting. Birinchi: men uni olaman. Ikkinchi: men uni olmayman. Uchinchi: men uni qoldirdim. To‘rtinchi: men uni olaman (palto). “Ushtarihi” va “tarakhtuh” ni ishlating.
scenes.say: I will take it. I will not take it. I left it. I will take the coat.
scenes.say_uz: Men uni olaman. Men uni olmayman. Men uni qoldirdim. Men uni (palto) olaman.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: ushtarihi. Lā ushtarihi. Akhdhuh. Tarakhtuh. “Ushtarihi” — men uni olaman. “Lā ushtarihi” — men uni olmayman. “Akhdhuh” — men uni olaman. “Tarakhtuh” — men uni qoldirdim. Endi oxirgi dialog ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: Ushtarihi. La ushtarihi. Akhdhuh. Tarakhtuh.
scenes.say_uz: Ushtarihi. La ushtarihi. Akhdhuh. Tarakhtuh.

scenes.title: Raqamlar: o‘n bir dan yigirigacha
scenes.say_native: Raqamlar: “aḥada ʿashara” — o‘n bir, “ithnā ʿashara” — o‘n ikki, “thalāthatā ʿashara” — o‘n uch, “arbaʿatā ʿashara” — o‘n to‘rt, “khāmitā ʿashara” — o‘n besh. “Thamanuhu sittata ʿashara dirham” — uning narhi o‘n olti so‘m. “Thamanuhu sabʿata ʿashara dirham” — o‘n yetti so‘m. Narhni aytishda bu raqamlar kerak bo‘ladi. “Miʾah” — yuz, “alf” — ming. Endi narhni aytamiz.
scenes.say: Ahada ashra, ithna ashra, thalatha ashra, arbaata ashra.
scenes.say_uz: Ahada ashra, ithna ashra, salasa ashra, arbaa ashra.

scenes.title: Narh ayting
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Beshta narhni arabcha ayting: o‘n bir so‘m, o‘n ikki so‘m, o‘n uch so‘m, o‘n to‘rt so‘m, o‘n besh so‘m. “Thamanuhu ... dirham” shaklida ayting.
scenes.say: Eleven som. Twelve som. Thirteen som. Fourteen som. Fifteen som.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n bir so‘m. O‘n ikki so‘m. O‘n uch so‘m. O‘n to‘rt so‘m. O‘n besh so‘m.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: thamanuhu aḥada ʿashara dirhaman. Thamanuhu ithnā ʿashara dirhaman. Thamanuhu thalāthatā ʿashara dirhaman. Thamanuhu arbaʿatā ʿashara dirhaman. “Dirhaman” — so‘m, obyekt shakli “-an” bilan. “Thamanuhu” — uning narhi. Endi “men uni olaman” (bu birini) ni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Thamanu hu ahada ashra dirham. Thamanu hu ithna ashra dirham.
scenes.say_uz: Uning narhi o‘n bir so‘m. Uning narhi o‘n ikki so‘m.

scenes.title: Men uni olaman (bu birini)
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta gapni arabcha ayting. Birinchi: men uni (bu kirtkani) olaman. Ikkinchi: men uni (shu paltoni) olaman. Uchinchi: men uni olmayman. To‘rtinchi: men uni (qora shimni) olaman. “Hādhā al-qamīṣa ushtarihi” — bu kirtkani olaman. “Hādhihi al-jubbata ushtariha” — bu paltoni olaman. “Lā ushtarihi” — olmayman.
scenes.say: I will take this shirt. I will take that coat. I will not take it. I will take the black trousers.
scenes.say_uz: Bu kirtkani olaman. Shu paltoni olaman. Men uni olmayman. Qora shimni olaman.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: hādhā al-qamīṣa ushtarihi. Hādhihi al-jubbata ushtariha. Lā ushtarihi. As-sirwāla al-aswada ushtarihi. “Hādhā al-qamīṣa” — bu kirtkani (obyekt “-a”). “Hādhihi al-jubbata” — bu paltoni. “As-sirwāla al-aswada” — qora shimni. Endi ikkinchi dialog ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: Hatha al qamisa ushtarihi. Hathihi al jubbata ushtariha. La ushtarihi. Assirwala al aswada ushtarihi.
scenes.say_uz: Bu kirtkani olaman. Shu paltoni olaman. Men uni olmayman. Qora shimni olaman.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Ranglarni o‘rgandik: abyaḍ, aswad, aḥmar, akhḍar, azraq, aṣfar, bunnī, rumādī. Kiyimlarni: qamīṣ, sirwāl, ḥidhāʾ, jubbah, thawb, qubbaʿa, khuff, qifāz. Rang ismga mos keladi. “Hādhā/hādhihi” — bu, “dhālika/tilka” — shu. Hajm: kabīr, ṣaghīr, wasaṭ. Xarid: “urīdu an ujarrībahu”, “kam thamanuhu?”. Eng muhim fikr: rang va hajm isminga mos keladi.
scenes.say: Colours, clothes, this/that, sizes, trying on and price.
scenes.say_uz: Ranglar, kiyim, bu/shu, hajm, kiritish va narh.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi. Kiymagan kiyimingizni arabcha tasvirlang va do‘kon’da palto xaridlashni simulyatsiya qiling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida 5 ta gap, rangning ismga mos kelishi, “bu” yoki “shu” belgisi, hajm va to‘g‘ri narh so‘rash. Keyingi darsda so‘roq gaplar tuzishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Homework: describe what you are wearing and role-play buying a jacket.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: kiymagan kiyimingizni tasvirlang va palto xaridlashni simulyatsiya qiling.

homework_uz: Kiymagan kiyimingizni arabcha tasvirlang va do‘kon’da palto xaridlashni simulyatsiya qiling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida 5 ta gap, rangning ismga mos kelishi, “bu” yoki “shu” belgisi, hajm va to‘g‘ri narh so‘rash.
